issues.concern: The main gloss combines two distinct meanings of the headword, which can be confusing for an intermediate learner. The second meaning 'year (of service)' is not a direct synonym of 'annual' or 'yearly'.
issues.suggestion: Split the gloss into two distinct meanings or rephrase to clearly separate them, e.g., 'annual; yearly; year (of service/enrollment)' or 'annual; yearly; seniority'.
